question.text: The order of the differential equation of the family of curves <math><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><msub><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><msup><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msub><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><msup><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><msub><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></msup></math> is (where, <math><msub><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></math> are arbitrary constants)

solution.text:
The given family of curves is y=k12k2x+k33k43x=k12k2x+k53x
which has ‘3’ arbitrary constants.
Hence, the order will be ‘three’
